check: klt array-check -- structural regularity of the committed array

array.hierarchy: macro -> 32 x bit_slice (x pitch 5.74 um) -> 2 x bl_pair (x=0 R0, x=5.74 M90) -> 128 x bitcell (mirrored-pair y pitch 7.21 um, alternating R0/M0)

not_covered: Connectivity: array-check is purely geometric. It says nothing about whether the abutting risers are electrically joined -- that is macro-record-decoder.json and #30 (LVS).
Design rules: no DRC. layout/reports/drc-macro.json is the DRC record.

The array as a whole: the abutment check is one-dimensional, so no invocation covers the 128 x 64 array in one pass. The two clean runs cover one column along y and the 32 slices along x; nothing checks the two axes jointly (klayout-tools#5698).
A blanket --tolerance is symmetric: the 0.27 um / 0.48 um above would equally mask a real gap or overlap up to the same size at a seam. The tolerances are justified by measurement, not by the check.
The periphery: only bitcell, bl_pair and bit_slice placements are checked.

upstream_tool_gaps.2AMLogic/klayout-tools#5698: 1-D abutment model for a 2-D array; no shared-edge/expected-overlap concept distinct from a measurement tolerance; `array-check --format json` omits the provenance block its sibling verbs emit

invocations.name: macro-slice-abutment
invocations.intent: the 32 bit_slice columns abut along x at the slice pitch
invocations.command: klt array-check layout/sram_256x32/macro.gds --cell bit_slice --pitch 5.74 --count 32 --direction x --tolerance 0.48 --format json
invocations.tolerance_rationale: 0.48 um is the measured shared-edge overlap of the column seam -- the mirror abutment of the two bl_pair halves shares that edge by design (layout/README.md, 'Supply rails'). At --tolerance 0 the same run reports that 0.48 um as an overlap. It is not slack.

invocations.name: macro-column-abutment
invocations.intent: the 128 bitcells of one column abut along y at the mirrored-pair half pitch
invocations.command: klt clip layout/sram_256x32/macro.gds --cell bl_pair -o <work>/bl_pair.gds && klt array-check <work>/bl_pair.gds --cell bitcell --pitch 3.605 --count 128 --direction y --tolerance 0.27 --format json
invocations.tolerance_rationale: 0.27 um is the measured shared-edge overlap of the row seam, where the mirror abutment merges the bitcell VDD/VSS risers (layout/README.md, 'Supply rails'). At --tolerance 0 the run reports 0.27 um / 0.15 um seam overlaps and a 0.15 um length error; a sweep gives 64 violations at 0.15 and clean at 0.27. It is not slack.

invocations.name: column-translation-symmetry
invocations.intent: one column is invariant under a one-mirrored-pair (+7.21 um) y translation
invocations.command: klt clip layout/sram_256x32/macro.gds --cell bl_pair -o <work>/bl_pair.gds && klt array-check <work>/bl_pair.gds --cell bl_pair --translate '0,7.21' --layers '[[1,0],[5,0],[8,0],[10,0]]' --format json
invocations.expectation: characterized: 8 residuals in exactly two y bands, both explained below. NOT a pass, and NOT to be tolerance-tuned away -- raising --tolerance until this reports clean would mask a future break of interior symmetry. The residual count and the two bands are the regression guard.

why_not_a_defect: y 7.065..7.355 is the finite-array end: under a +7.21 um shift no partner geometry exists beyond the last mirrored pair, so the edge cannot be symmetric. An infinite array would have no residual here.

y 461.440..461.585 is seam 0, which layout/README.md already records as special: it sits on the bit-line Via1/Via2 stacks below the array, so it is a pad per column plus a Metal4 strap instead of the full-width Metal2 strap every other seam gets.
The array interior is residual-free: no residual lies between the two bands.

invocations.name: tile2x2-abutment-limitation
invocations.intent: minimal reproducer of the one-dimensional abutment model, on the committed 2x2 mirror tile (4 bitcell_leaf placements, 2 x 2)
invocations.expectation: violated: a tool limitation, not a layout defect. The check counts every placement in the 2-D tile (4) against the per-row count (2), measures array length across both rows (6.22 um != 2 x 2.87 um), and projects the two y-stacked placements onto x as spurious full-cell 3.35 um overlaps. The same shape at 128 x 64 scale is why the whole-array abutment check is not expressible. Filed upstream as klayout-tools#5698.

violations.description: array length 6.22 um != count x pitch 5.74 um

provenance.note: array-check is deck-independent (purely geometric: no PDK deck, no compact models, no SPICE). klt emits no provenance block for this verb, so this block is added by ./layout/reports/generate-array-check.sh from `klt env-provenance emit`; its host_id/os/python_version fields are dropped so the record reproduces on any host.
